title: The Latest: A Call to ‘Fox & Friends’

sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是安德鲁·罗斯-索金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for DealBook, a daily newsletter at the New York Times.
sentences.zh: 我负责《纽约时报》每日简报 DealBook 的商业与政策报道。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市 DealBook 峰会的现场采访一些商业、政治和文化领域最具影响力的领袖，包括 J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine Lagarde, Zilran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the DealBook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜·拉加德、齐尔兰·蒙达尼以及许多其他人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 你可以实时观看其中一些毫无防备、未经过滤的对话。

sentences.en: We're going to be live-streaming select interviews for anyone to watch, free, at nytimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我们将在 nytimes.com 上直播部分精选采访，供任何人免费观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订阅者，可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序进行观看，并获得一个月的免费阅读权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望大家能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你不会想错过它的。

sentences.en: It started with a whistleblower's complaint about President Trump's contact with a foreign leader.
sentences.zh: 这一切始于一名吹哨人对特朗普总统与外国领导人接触的投诉。

sentences.en: I had a perfect phone call with the president of Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 我和乌克兰总统有一次完美的通话。

sentences.en: Like, I mean, perfect.
sentences.zh: 我是说，简直完美。

sentences.en: Today, I'm announcing the House of Representatives moving forward with an official impeachment inquiry.
sentences.zh: 今天，我宣布众议院将推进正式的弹劾调查。

sentences.en: It is our great pleasure to welcome the president of the United States, Donald Trump, calling in.
sentences.zh: 我们非常荣幸地迎来了正在致电的美国总统唐纳德·特朗普。

sentences.en: Mr. Trump, good morning to you.
sentences.zh: 特朗普先生，早安。

sentences.en: Good morning.
sentences.zh: 早安。

sentences.en: It's Julie Davis in the Washington Bureau of the New York Times.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》华盛顿分社的朱莉·戴维斯。

sentences.en: The latest is that, after two weeks of public impeachment hearings, President Trump had a lot to get off his cheSt.
sentences.zh: 最新消息是，在经历了长达两周的公开弹劾听证会后，特朗普总统有很多话要一吐为快。

sentences.en: Good to have you on Fox & Friends today.
sentences.zh: 很高兴你今天能来参加《福克斯与朋友们》节目。

sentences.en: As you said in your tweet, another slow news week.
sentences.zh: 正如你在推特上所说，这又是一个新闻淡季。

sentences.en: One by one.
sentences.zh: 一个接一个。

sentences.en: Okay, first of all, Volker, I don't know him.
sentences.zh: 好吧，首先，沃尔克，我不认识他。

sentences.en: He's trying to discredit the witnesses in the inquiry so far.
sentences.zh: 他试图抹黑迄今为止调查中的证人。

sentences.en: Kurt Volker.
sentences.zh: 库尔特·沃尔克。

sentences.en: Don't know him.
sentences.zh: 不认识。

sentences.en: Kurt Volker.
sentences.zh: 库尔特·沃尔克。

sentences.en: This guy, Sondland, hardly know him.
sentences.zh: 这家伙，桑德兰，我几乎不认识他。

sentences.en: I've had a couple of conversations with him.
sentences.zh: 我和他有过几次谈话。

sentences.en: I see him hanging around, you know, when I go to Europe.
sentences.zh: 我看到他在周围晃悠，你知道的，当我去了欧洲的时候。

sentences.en: Gordon Sondland.
sentences.zh: 戈登·桑德兰。

sentences.en: Look, the ambassador, the woman.
sentences.zh: 听着，那个大使，那个女人。

sentences.en: Marie Yovanovitch.
sentences.zh: 玛丽·约万诺维奇。

sentences.en: She wouldn't even put up.
sentences.zh: 她甚至不肯顺从。

sentences.en: She's an Obama person, you know.
sentences.zh: 她是个奥巴马的人，你知道的。

sentences.en: But I said, why are you being so kind?
sentences.zh: 但我说，你们为什么对她这么客气？

sentences.en: Well, sir, she's a woman.
sentences.zh: 嗯，先生，她是个女人。

sentences.en: We have to be nice.
sentences.zh: 我们必须对她好一点。

sentences.en: David Holmes.
sentences.zh: 大卫·霍姆斯。

sentences.en: How about the guy with the telephone?
sentences.zh: 那这个拿着电话的家伙呢？

sentences.en: How about that one?
sentences.zh: 那家伙怎么样？

sentences.en: I guarantee you that never took place.
sentences.zh: 我向你保证，那根本没有发生过。

sentences.en: He said he's sitting there listening to me.
sentences.zh: 他说他坐在那里听我说话。

sentences.en: And he gave kind of a preview of what the Republican impeachment response will be and what his reaction is going to be as this whole thing unfolds.
sentences.zh: 他基本上预告了共和党对弹劾的反应，以及随着整个事件的发展，他将会有什么反应。

sentences.en: A lot of it had to do, they say, with Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 他们说，这很大程度上与乌克兰有关。

sentences.en: Which is that everything the president did, he did because of corruption in Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 也就是说，总统所做的一切，都是因为乌克兰存在腐败问题。

sentences.en: He did because he essentially was the victim of this scheme that Ukraine was trying to pull off.
sentences.zh: 他这么做是因为他本质上是乌克兰试图实施的这个阴谋的受害者。

sentences.en: But, Mr. President.
sentences.zh: 但是，总统先生。

sentences.en: You know, it's very interesting.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这非常有趣。

sentences.en: It's very interesting.
sentences.zh: 这非常有趣。

sentences.en: They have the server, right, from the DNC, Democratic National Committee.
sentences.zh: 他们有服务器，对吧，来自 DNC，即民主党全国委员会。

sentences.en: Who has the server?
sentences.zh: 谁有服务器？

sentences.en: Well, the FBI went in and they told him, get out of here.
sentences.zh: 嗯，联邦调查局进去了，他们告诉对方，滚开。

sentences.en: You're not kidding.
sentences.zh: 你不是在开玩笑吧。

sentences.en: We're not giving it to you.
sentences.zh: 我们不会把它给你们。

sentences.en: They gave the server to CrowdStrike or whatever it's called, which is a company owned by a very wealthy Ukrainian.
sentences.zh: 他们把服务器给了 CrowdStrike 还是叫什么名字的公司，那是一家由一个非常富有的乌克兰人拥有的公司。

sentences.en: And I still want to see that server.
sentences.zh: 我仍然想看看那个服务器。

sentences.en: You know, the FBI has never gotten that server.
sentences.zh: 你知道，联邦调查局从来没有拿到那个服务器。

sentences.en: That's a big part of this whole thing.
sentences.zh: 这是整个事件中很重要的一部分。

sentences.en: Why did they give it to a Ukrainian company?
sentences.zh: 他们为什么要把它给一家乌克兰公司？

sentences.en: Are you sure they did that?
sentences.zh: 你确定他们这么做了吗？

sentences.en: In short, he's saying that Ukraine, not Russia, was behind interference in the 2016 election.
sentences.zh: 简而言之，他是说乌克兰而不是俄罗斯，才是 2016 年大选干预的幕后黑手。

sentences.en: So why wouldn't he reevaluate or question or ask Ukraine to investigate?
sentences.zh: 所以他为什么不重新评估、质疑或要求乌克兰进行调查呢？

sentences.en: And why wouldn't he be skeptical of having a White House meeting or sending hundreds of millions of dollars in American military assistance money to Ukraine?
sentences.zh: 他为什么不对与乌克兰举行白宫会晤或向其提供数亿美元的美国军事援助资金保持怀疑态度呢？

sentences.en: Are you sure they gave it to Ukraine?
sentences.zh: 你确定他们把它给了乌克兰？

sentences.en: Well, that's what the word is.
sentences.zh: 嗯，传闻是这样的。

sentences.en: And that's what I asked actually in my phone call, if you know.
sentences.zh: 这也是我在电话里问的，如果你知道的话。

sentences.en: I mean, I asked it very point blank because we're looking for corruption.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我问得很直白，因为我们在寻找腐败。

sentences.en: So this is interesting because, of course, just yesterday in the final day of the impeachment hearings of the week,
sentences.zh: 所以这很有趣，因为当然就在昨天，也就是本周弹劾听证会的最后一天，

sentences.en: as Democrats are kind of wrapping up their public case and getting ready to sort of sum it up in a big report for the public,
sentences.zh: 当民主党人即将结束他们的公开陈述，并准备在一份面向公众的大型报告中进行总结时，

sentences.en: their witness, Fiona Hill, who was the top Europe and Russia expert at the National Security Council, almost seemed to anticipate this.
sentences.zh: 他们的证人菲奥娜·希尔——国家安全委员会的顶级欧洲和俄罗斯专家——几乎预料到了这一点。

sentences.en: Some of you on this committee appear to believe that Russia and its security services did not conduct a campaign against our country
sentences.zh: 你们委员会的一些人似乎认为，俄罗斯及其安全部门没有对我们国家发起竞选活动，

sentences.en: and that perhaps, somehow, for some reason, Ukraine did.
sentences.zh: 并且也许由于某种原因，乌克兰这样做了。

sentences.en: This is a fictional narrative that has been perpetrated and propagated by the Russian security services themselves.
sentences.zh: 这是一个由俄罗斯安全部门自己炮制和传播的虚构叙事。

sentences.en: She told Republicans in the room this idea that Ukraine influenced the election, this idea that it was Ukraine that meddled and not Russia, it's fiction.
sentences.zh: 她对在场的共和党人说，乌克兰影响大选的这种说法，这种是乌克兰而不是俄罗斯进行干预的说法，纯属虚构。

sentences.en: The unfortunate truth is that Russia was the foreign power that systematically attacked our democratic institutions in 2016.
sentences.zh: 不幸的事实是，俄罗斯才是 2016 年系统性攻击我们民主机构的外国势力。

sentences.en: I say this not as an alarmist, but as a realiSt.
sentences.zh: 我这么说不是作为一个危言耸听者，而是作为一个现实主义者。

sentences.en: In the course of this investigation, I would ask that you please not promote politically-deriven falsehoods that so clearly advance Russian interests.
sentences.zh: 在这项调查过程中，我恳请你们不要宣扬那些明显推进俄罗斯利益的政治衍生虚假信息。

sentences.en: These fictions are harmful even if they're deployed for purely domestic political purposes.
sentences.zh: 即使这些虚构内容是出于纯粹的国内政治目的而被采用的，它们也是有害的。

sentences.en: Not only is it fiction, but it's fiction that is essentially a Russian disinformation campaign that is designed to interfere with American democracy.
sentences.zh: 这不仅是虚构，而且这种虚构本质上是一场旨在干涉美国民主的俄罗斯虚假信息战。

sentences.en: Right now, Russia's security services and their proxies have geared up to repeat their interference in the 2020 election.
sentences.zh: 目前，俄罗斯的安全部门及其代理人已经准备好在 2020 年大选中重复他们的干涉行为。

sentences.en: We are running out of time to stop them.
sentences.zh: 我们阻止他们的时间已经不多了。

sentences.en: And, you know,
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，

sentences.en: the Times reported this afternoon that Fiona Hill's testimony aligns with information that the American intelligence community has actually been sharing with senators in recent weeks
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》今天下午报道称，菲奥娜·希尔的证词与美国情报界最近几周一直在与参议员分享的信息一致，

sentences.en: and telling them over the last couple of weeks that they've discovered that Russia for years has tried to frame Ukraine as the nation behind the 2016 hacking to say that it wasn't us,
sentences.zh: 并在过去几周告诉他们，他们发现俄罗斯多年来一直试图将乌克兰诬陷为 2016 年黑客攻击事件的幕后黑手，以声称不是我们，

sentences.en: it was Ukraine that framed us.
sentences.zh: 是乌克兰陷害了我们。

sentences.en: But based on what we saw on TV this morning, it seems like this is going to be central to the president's impeachment defense.
sentences.zh: 但根据我们今天早上在电视上看到的，这似乎将成为总统弹劾辩护的核心。

sentences.en: He's not dismissing this as a conspiracy theory.
sentences.zh: 他并没有把这当作阴谋论来驳回。

sentences.en: He's embracing this as kind of the core of his own defense in the impeachment case.
sentences.zh: 他将此作为其在弹劾案中自身辩护的核心。

sentences.en: And furthermore, frankly, I want a trial.
sentences.zh: 而且坦率地说，我还想要一场审判。

sentences.en: You know, I could think I could have it.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我想我能得到它。

sentences.en: You want a trial?
sentences.zh: 你想要一场审判？

sentences.en: Whatever I want.
sentences.zh: 无论我想要什么。

sentences.en: Oh, I wouldn't.
sentences.zh: 哦，我不会的。

sentences.en: Look, we're starting to see signs that this is also the story we're going to be hearing in the Senate once the House, more likely than not,
sentences.zh: 看，我们开始看到迹象表明，这也是我们在参议院将听到的故事，一旦众议院极有可能在未来几周内，

sentences.en: votes to impeach Trump in the coming weeks, sending things to a trial in the Senate, which is controlled by Republicans.
sentences.zh: 投票弹劾特朗普，将案件提交给由共和党控制的参议院进行审判。

sentences.en: Lindsey Graham, who is the Republican chairman of the Judiciary Committee, wrote to the State Department this week asking for documents about Joe Biden and his son Hunter Biden,
sentences.zh: 司法委员会共和党主席林赛·格雷厄姆本周致信国务院，要求获得关于乔·拜登及其儿子亨特·拜登的文件，

sentences.en: who sat on the board of this Ukrainian energy company, their contact with the former Ukrainian president,
sentences.zh: 后者曾担任这家乌克兰能源公司董事会成员，以及他们与前乌克兰总统的接触，

sentences.en: the contacts that other members of the Obama administration had with Ukrainians in the paSt.
sentences.zh: 以及奥巴马政府其他成员过去与乌克兰人的接触。

sentences.en: It's all a sign that he's going to try to lay out in hearings some sort of alternate narrative to what the Democrats have been presenting in the House.
sentences.zh: 这一切都表明，他将试图在听证会上提出某种与民主党在众议院提出的叙事不同的叙事。

sentences.en: And it looks like that's the same narrative the president was promoting today and that Fiona Hill and American intelligence officials have been warning about.
sentences.zh: 看起来这正是总统今天一直在宣扬的叙事，也是菲奥娜·希尔和美国情报官员一直发出警告的叙事。

sentences.en: I'm not a doctor, but if I was running a prescription, calling in every week to update the country about what's happening might be good for your health.
sentences.zh: 我不是医生，但如果我在开药方，每周打电话来向全国更新最新进展可能对你的健康有益。

sentences.en: That's something to consider.
sentences.zh: 这是值得考虑的事情。

sentences.en: You have the phone number.
sentences.zh: 你有这个电话号码。

sentences.en: Well, you know that I've been doing it for years.
sentences.zh: 嗯，你知道我这么做已经好几年了。

sentences.en: With your group, I've been doing it for years.
sentences.zh: 和你们这个团体一起，我这么做已经好几年了。

sentences.en: The stress release.
sentences.zh: 这能释放压力。

sentences.en: If it was up to me, and it is up to me, and we'll do it more often, but I have a lot of fun doing it.
sentences.zh: 如果由我决定——而且确实由我决定，我们会更频繁地这样做——但我做这件事很有乐趣。

sentences.en: And you know what?
sentences.zh: 你知道吗？

sentences.en: The nice part, we get the true word out.
sentences.zh: 好的一面是，我们把真实的声音传了出去。

sentences.en: And that's the lateSt. We'll be back when things pick up after Congress's holiday break.
sentences.zh: 这就是最新消息。国会假期结束后，情况有所好转时我们会再回来。

sentences.en: This week on The Wirecutter Show, we're getting ready for hosting over the holidays.
sentences.zh: 本周的《打捞者秀》中，我们正在为假期的款待做准备。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 收听节目，了解如何让你的客人在家一般自在的秘诀。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们是深度睡眠者吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they blackout to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们会晕厥过去睡觉。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我是说，他们需要什么样的光线？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为这是一个非常具体的要求。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有对什么过敏或饮食禁忌吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢喝咖啡还是茶？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？

sentences.zh: 在《纽约时报》应用程序或你喜欢收听的任何地方寻找《打捞者秀》。
